note: County of St. Paul campground in a naturally wooded area south of Floatingstone Lake, 4 km west and 8 km north of Ashmont: forested loops set back behind a sandy swimming beach, with a dock, a boat launch rebuilt in 2024, a rentable beach gazebo and a 24-hour park attendant. --Claude
summary: Confirmed on the county pages and Let's Camp: 65 sites (46 with 30-amp power), C$25 non-power / C$35 power + C$5 reservation fee, online/phone only, 14-night max, May long Friday to Labour Day, 40-ft max on Let's Camp, showers/Wi-Fi/dump. nightly_high 35 -> 25 (base). WATERFRONT: lakeview -> not waterfront recommended (pads 80-120 m from the shore in dense forest).
flags: WATERFRONT (recommend lakeview -> not waterfront): the county's 2022 campground map (https://www.county.stpaul.ab.ca/wp-content/uploads/2021/12/Floating-Stone-2022-Map.pdf) puts every site in loops south of the beach, parking lots and a continuous tree belt; the lakeside sites are 5-16 on the first loop and 43-44 at the NE group-site end. On Esri imagery (1 m/px) the nearest pads of those loops are about 80-120 m from open water with dense spruce/aspen forest between; the only open ground to the water is the day-use beach and its parking lots. No source says any site has a lake view (the county: 'in a naturally wooded area abutting the south shore'; Let's Camp site descriptions say nothing of the lake). Unsure after every source, so downgrade.
